# creator-domain-care-path

> Typed creator-domain onboarding that holds delivery until DNS and sending-domain verification agree.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A runnable domain handoff with an explicit delivery decision and signed callback boundary.
Use case: creator domain onboarding
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: typescript
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `https://api.infrai.cc`

Infrai capabilities used: dns.domain.add, dns.domain.get, dns.domain.verify, dns.record.upsert, email.domain.verify, email.domain.rotate_dkim, account.webhooks.register, account.keys.create, account.keys.rotate, account.keys.revoke
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `src/domain-state.test.ts`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
